parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and graphical content. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed to the base and does not move independently in most designs, though it may tilt slightly in some models.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and maintains stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, ensuring it remains upright and stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move, though it may allow limited tilt or swivel motion depending on the design.
